hook.en: Want an angel to make dua specifically for you today?

hadith.en: The Prophet, peace be upon him, said: The supplication of a Muslim for his brother in his absence is answered. At his head is an appointed angel; whenever he supplicates for his brother with good, the angel says: Amin, and for you the same. Reported by Muslim.

explain1.en: Shaykh Ibn Uthaymeen, may Allah have mercy on him, explained: Praying for someone in secret is pure sincerity. You seek neither praise nor thanks from them, so Allah rewards you with the very thing you asked for your brother.

explain2.en: And Shaykh Ibn Baz said: Whenever you see a brother in hardship or needing guidance, make dua for him in private. The angel immediately replies: Amin, and for you the same.

close.en: Share it, and may Allah accept your deeds.
